fx_rate_date: local calendar date of the document timestamp in manifest.timezone
payment_allocation_amount: unallocated_minor = invoice_ref.amount_minor - allocated_minor; for a foreign payment allocated_minor = round_half_even(allocated_base_minor / rate * 10^exp_src / 10^exp_base) with the rate of the invoice's fx_rate_date
period_boundary: a document belongs to the period if its local date (manifest.timezone) is within [period_start, period_end] inclusive
rounding: ROUND_HALF_EVEN to the minor unit of the target currency
